newsItems.label: Sports News
newsItems.title: CYON YOUTH WEEK SPORTS
newsItems.description: CYON youth week sports officially commences
newsItems.excerpt: CYON youth week sports officially commences with parish excitement and strong youth participation.
newsItems.content:
CYON youth week sports officially commences at Our Lady of Lourdes Catholic Church, Maryland, Enugu.

The parish youth community has come together with energy, friendship, and faith-filled joy for this year's activities. Families and parish groups are encouraged to support the young people throughout the week.

newsItems.content:
Parish outreach and service continue to bring faith and support into the community.

Members of the parish joined together in a spirit of charity, prayer, and practical help, showing the church's presence beyond the sanctuary.
